dek: Zaidi said: Iraq spared 'international isolation that was only days away'; the government has completed the weapons file with 3 armed factions and is negotiating with 4 others; 'consolidating all arms under the authority of the state is a final and irreversible decision'; 'there are no US soldiers…
sources: Iraqi PM Ali al-Zaidi, interview with Al Iraqiya television, reported by the Iraqi News Agency (INA), via Al Jazeera liveblog 19:45 GMT Oct 23
